working_title: Evaluating change-balanced supervision in longitudinal glioma MRI
purpose: Design one R36 main result figure without new measurements, fitting, significance tests, or a claim of novelty.

shared_caption.task: Observed two-scan anatomical change, not future prediction
shared_caption.direction: Lower error is better; negative candidate-minus-comparator differences favor the candidate
shared_caption.aggregation: Average pair errors within patient, then average equally across patients; average errors over fitted seeds, not ensemble predictions
shared_caption.fitting_budget: Locked R36 final-epoch recipe: twelve encoder arms and thirty source-only probes, twenty epochs each; original total ceiling twenty-four GPU-hours; no refitting for this figure
shared_caption.probe_training: The 52 source-training patients only; identical local probe recipe for the objective comparison

sailor.status: Reused development transfer; no R36 weight fitting or checkpoint selection on these patients

shared_caption.intervals: Use saved family-three-adjusted paired-patient bootstrap intervals; 10000 draws, seed 2026, conditional on the three fitted seeds
shared_caption.limits: Automated targets, reused cohorts, no biological validation or untouched generalization; an interval crossing zero is inconclusive, not equivalence

panels.title: Trained decoder scores
panels.display: Grouped points or bars; no inferential error bars
panels.description: Compare the unbalanced B and change-balanced C nonlinear heads within each cohort. This is a descriptive trained-output result, not a frozen-encoder result.
panels.uncertainty: No saved contrast interval is assigned to this descriptive panel. Do not fabricate one or attach the frozen-probe interval.

panels.title: Frozen-probe objective contrasts
panels.display: Difference-and-interval plot with a zero reference line
panels.description: C minus B is the primary objective-only comparison. C minus A and D minus C are labeled companion frozen-probe comparisons, not state-retention comparisons.
panels.uncertainty: Retain the saved family-three intervals and INCONCLUSIVE classifications. Do not interpret a small point difference as evidence of no encoder effect.

panels.title: Incremental-information controls
panels.display: Difference-and-interval plot on a separate axis with a zero reference line
panels.description: Show both C and D against later-scan-only probes and differences of independently decoded states. Beating the former does not establish a gain over the latter.
panels.uncertainty: Use the saved family-three patient intervals. These are observed-change controls, not matched latest-scan forecasting controls.

panels.title: Development-transfer companion
panels.display: Paired descriptive points for every arm, with zero-change reference
panels.description: Include A, B, C, D and original R35. Compare each frozen difference probe with its independent decoded-state difference. Do not select an arm from transfer outcomes.
panels.uncertainty: Descriptive means only. No new paired transfer interval or hypothesis classification is inferred.

required_paper_companions: All A/B/C/D/R35 state and local controls, with both development cohorts, including the ungraded A/R35 nonlinear heads
C minus A direct native log-volume retention result against the locked +0.05 allowance
D minus C measured direct-state and noise worsening, bias benefit, unresolved tradeoff, and standardization caveat
Empty-compartment failures and automated-target, geometry, provenance and independent-validation limits
A separate R35 context table using native log-volume units and its own descriptive/adjusted interval rules, not an unlabeled shared axis
publication_claim_boundary: Candidate empirical extension of existing pair/state and frozen-probe literature, not first use of those ideas, equivalence, future dynamics, biological prediction, or a new world-model method
rendering_boundary: No plot or HTML was generated. If implemented later, use the existing figure-maintenance contract, preserve this public aggregate as the measurement source, and render and inspect pixels before claiming figure review.
